title: Align schc_generic test source with current fragmentation API
description: After format-v2 vector generation succeeds, pinned Zephyr v3.7 native_sim compilation fails in lichen/tests/schc_generic/src/main.c assert_delivered(): it initializes removed schc_fragmenter_config fields (window_bits, fcn_bits, tile_size, mtu, direction, mode), references removed SCHC_FRAGMENT_UPLINK/NO_ACK enums, and passes an array pointer plus undeclared packet_len to schc_reassembler_packet. Update the focused test to the current API without reducing coverage. Acceptance: pinned schc_generic builds and runs all generated v2 scenarios.
